column1: # bb_junction_basebeta_2_3_flush3 -- the b|b base junction of Group B is REALIZABLE.
# Instance: m=1 base-beta target at (e,f)=(2,3), N=23, tile (a,b,c)=(6,5,9).
# Columns x_i are exact rationals; y_i are exact rational COEFFICIENTS of r.
# WHAT THIS IS.  Group B of room e2b's trichotomy is the single word `acabbca`, whose only
# same-letter base junction is b|b, at x = 6+9+6+5 = 31 on the base.  Room e2b2's Erdos brief
# asked whether the order-free boundary-figure trichotomy
#   (TileAt.congruentDissection_boundary_figure_cases: a non-vertex boundary figure is
#    exactly {3a,2b} or {a,b,g}, where here 3*alpha+2*beta = pi exactly)
# kills b|b outright.  IT DOES NOT.  A b-edge's endpoints carry {alpha,gamma}; of the four
# flanking combinations only (gamma,gamma) dies (2*gamma > pi).  The combination
# (alpha,gamma) is not merely angle-consistent: it is FLUSH-realizable, and this file is the
# realization, placed at the word's actual junction abscissa inside the actual target.
# The three tiles:
#   L  = the 4th base tile, b-edge [26,31] x {0}, presenting alpha at x=31, gamma at x=26
#   Rt = the 5th base tile, b-edge [31,36] x {0}, presenting gamma at x=31, alpha at x=36
#   M  = the filler, presenting beta at x=31; its c-edge (9) is flush with L's c-edge and its
#        a-edge (6) is flush with Rt's a-edge -- no T-point anywhere in the patch.
#   Their union is the trapezoid (26,0)-(36,0)-(29,r)-(24,r): parallel sides 10 and 5,
#   legs 9 and 6, height r; area 3 * 10*sqrt(2) = 3 tile areas exactly.
# VERIFIED 2026-09-12 (room e2b2, Erdos seat), exact arithmetic, squared distances
# d2 = dx^2 + 32*dy^2 over Q:
#   3/3 tiles congruent to (6,5,9)   [squared sides {25,36,81}, exactly]
#   3/3 tiles of area exactly 10*sqrt(2)  [shoelace, exactly]
#   all 5 distinct vertices inside the target: with y_sqrt2 = 4*y_r, the two leg half-planes
#   (re-verified from disk in the same session, per NOVELTY_PROTOCOL sec. 5)
#   pairwise interiors disjoint: the three tiles occupy disjoint angular sectors at (31,0),
#     spanning 180deg -> 141.06deg -> 109.47deg -> 0deg, i.e. alpha, beta, gamma, sum pi.
# WHAT THIS DOES NOT SHOW.  It does not produce a tiling.  N=23 is NO_TILING by certified
# search (data/SETTLED.tsv, 19 677 nodes), so this patch provably does not extend.  Its role
# is exactly negative-for-the-hope / positive-for-the-object: pointwise angle counting cannot
# refute Group B, because the configuration it would have to refute exists.
